title: Notes on Live Streaming (3): Who Are the Top Spenders, and Why Do They Pay?
summary: Drawing on over 1,200 hours of transcribed Bilibili virtual singing and chat streams, 740,000+ room-entry logs, and ¥514,000 in actual viewer spending, Part 3 tests industry assumptions against real data: dismantling the ten-cent conversion funnel myth, uncovering the salaried-worker and student reality behind "whales" in small and mid-sized rooms, and pinp…
content: Drawing on over 1,200 hours of transcribed Bilibili virtual singing and chat streams, 740,000+ room-entry logs, and ¥514,000 in actual viewer spending, Part 3 tests industry assumptions against real data: dismantling the ten-cent conversion funnel myth, uncovering the salaried-worker and student reality behind "whales" in small and mid-sized rooms, and pinpointing the three exact links that turn listeners into paying regulars.
